author: Living With Arthritis UK Editorial Team
direct_answer: Exercise is a core treatment for back arthritis, offering significant pain reduction comparable to medication. Recommended exercises include deep-core strengthening (pelvic tilts, bird-dog, glute bridges), spinal mobility (cat-cow, knee-to-chest), and low-impact aerobic activities like walking, cycling, or swimming. These help nourish discs, strengthen stabilising muscles, and improve posture without accelerating spinal degeneration.
